描述_EN: porcelains differ from other ceramics in their impermeability, whiteness and fine texture. the term porcelain is applied to ceramics made from a mixture containing a clay called kaolin and a white stone called petuntse, which was fired at high temperatures. this bowl is an example of ding ware, made in the hebei province of china during the northern song dynasty (960-1127). this bowl is typical of ding wares in its ivory-white hue and incised decoration. ding wares were of the earliest true porcelains made in china, and the world. the use of coal instead of firewood in the ding kilns also created a higher firing temperature and an ideal oxidising atmosphere, perfect for the production of ivory white ding porcelain. the lotus was strongly associated with buddhism, and was a popular motif in this period. the exterior is carved with an abstract lotus leaf pattern, and the inside with lotus flowers. it is possible the bowl, due to its size and decoration, was utilised in buddhist rituals.
描述_ZN: 瓷器与其他陶瓷的不同之处在于其不渗透性、白色和精细的纹理。 瓷器这一术语适用于由一种叫做高岭土的粘土和一种叫做petuntse的白色石头的混合物制成的陶瓷，在高温下烧制。 此碗是北宋时期中国河北制造的鼎器的一个例子。 此碗在象牙白的色调和刻画的装饰上是典型的鼎器。 丁器是中国乃至世界上最早的真正的瓷器。 鼎窑使用煤而不是木柴，也创造了更高的烧制温度和理想的氧化气氛，非常适合生产象牙白的鼎瓷。 荷花与佛教有着密切的联系，是这一时期的流行图案。 外部刻有抽象的荷叶图案，内部刻有荷花。 由于其尺寸和装饰，这只碗有可能被用于佛教仪式。
